oracle.scope: complete original declared namespace, kinds, modes, mtime, logical lengths, exact alias classes and every payload byte on a fresh published-root mount and persisted current-format public reads
oracle.omissions: current format grammar checked by existing public validators; retired encoding byte identity and unreferenced-object census are not comparison claims

differences: Global Store is in the Linux daemon shared volume and selected Disposable/WAL/OFF; v0.1.6 host Store and historical timer differ.

Warm-up repeats the original ordinary syscall body on a prior mount without Commit, then terminal unmount/automatic cleanup; measured Commit and publication are new work. Class B requires actual measured source-demand counters to be zero; any miss is INELIGIBLE.

Current persisted-root proof uses current typed/authenticated public Content/Storage/History readers over a closed exported sample Store, outside every product timer. It is an offline independent oracle, with no host data-serving or construction route. Retired canonical encoding is not interpreted as current encoding.

The original selected-verification policy has a 45 s work ceiling and 59 s hard watchdog for the complete proof run. These are copied and declared for the separate combined native/persisted proof; its timer/topology differ.

The original mixed-v4 verifier used selected background paths/ranges plus the moved subtree witness and deleted-subtree absence; the port checks the complete declared tree and every payload byte on both the mounted and persisted roots. This strengthens coverage without changing the workload or the original selected-verification ceilings.
